energy_it_uses: the fuel you state: your own plant (section 3)
manual_attribute_names: SH generation efficiency [-]; SH distribution efficiency [-]; SH emission efficiency [-]; SH regulation efficiency [-]; SH emission convective fraction [-]; SH emission target temperature [°C]; SH fuel; SH COP [-]; DHW generation efficiency [-]; DHW distribution efficiency [-]; DHW emission efficiency [-]; DHW regulation efficiency [-]; DHW fuel; DHW COP [-]; name; description

When the fuel is Electric, write generation efficiency 1.0 and put the machine in the COP (heat pump 3.2, electric heater 1, as stated in the note). Convective fraction examples stated in the note, not a measured plant: radiator 0.6, fan coil 1.0, radiant surface 0.35. EuReCa multiplies the four efficiencies. The report-house boiler row holds one filled example.
